purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the Stillwater Six protected-session disclosure fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for ordinary clinic-reset labor, split record custody, the white clinical privacy line, the clean audit shell, the purge clock, four disclosure routes, and eight state-gated outcomes.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the transfer-clinic establishing view, Room C reset routine, route and hardware evidence, authority positions at the privacy line, the clean disposition, audit response, purge order, disclosure threshold, and each ending family. The white purge ring beginning to contract is a pivotal beat and receives its own replay screen.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone for a general image model. It restates the visible room geometry, materials, lighting, bodies, clothing, tools, and evidence. Prompt assembly includes visual refs only for named characters and groups visible in that frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints and are excluded from assembled prompts.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: moody illustrated science-fiction workplace noir, ink-wash shadows with restrained teal, cream, amber, and steel-blue color, precise readable industrial objects, humane facial expression, quiet corporate absurdity, cinematic composition designed for click-through interactive fiction, purely pictorial interface marks rendered as simple bars, rings, and symbols.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each generated prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible named characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Each base_image_prompt is independently complete and does not rely on previous images or private lore.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture returns to one clinic bay from multiple angles and uses sightlines, a legal floor boundary, object custody, and a service route as branch mechanics. A draft plan map defines those relationships for B-level replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency website rendering, build a plan view or simple 3D blockout for the Stillwater Six public bay, Room C, service spine, staff alcove, curved entry doors, white privacy arc, maintenance counter, and auditor position. Use camera-specific blockout renders as image-model geometry input.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of Stillwater Six, a compact corporate alignment clinic built into one crescent of a rotating transfer habitat on an Enceladus pilgrimage route. Six cream recovery-room doors face a carpeted public waiting bay. A bright white arc crosses the floor as a clinical privacy boundary. Curved transparent entry doors show a dim transit concourse beyond. Brushed steel wall panels, teal calming light strips, a slow abstract wall display, towel shelves, drink cabinets, and a rolling linen cart make the clinic look soothing and heavily serviced. An open staff alcove occupies one end; a narrow gray service-spine doorway sits behind the recovery rooms. Esi Tan, a compact baseline-human hospitality worker in her early thirties with medium-brown skin, closely shaved black hair, pale gray wrap uniform, teal cleaning tab, and a rolling linen cart, resets Room C near the middle of the crescent.

review_notes: Draft scene_set map supplies fixed zones, camera slots, sightline lanes, and record-custody states for a multi-angle single-location fixture.
Every base prompt repeats enough geometry and appearance detail to stand alone; visual refs are included only for characters declared visible in that frame.
